01

### Grow with the industry leader

Earn commission on clients you refer to us, and connect with over 30,000 Intercom customers.

Partner with AI experts to build, implement, and customize solutions for your customers.

Get guidance from your dedicated partner manager on training, certifications, and integrations.

## Want to become an Intercom Partner?

01

### Apply

Agencies, BPOs, and SIs are welcome to apply. If you're a good fit, we'll schedule an intro call.

Apply now

02

### Sign

We'll share our official agreement with you. Once you've reviewed and signed it, you're set.

Apply now

03

### Onboard

Finally, we'll kick off your onboarding process so you can develop your Intercom strategy.

Apply now
